problems.quote: the human condition (n = 48), the human-AI condition (n = 48) and the poems generated in the AI condition (n = 50). Therefore, in sum, each poet evaluated the same set of 146 poems.
problems.note: The printed 146 is the entire three-condition collection, including 50 poems generated entirely by AI. This estimate contrasts only Human-AI condition (editor) with Human condition, each with 48 participants and one poem per participant. The AI-only benchmark is outside both recorded arms and is explicitly excluded by extraction rule 5. Under codebook sections 2 and 7, the observation count for this two-arm estimate must match its contrast, rather than the whole three-arm rating collection. Using the common three-arm ANOVA/LSD error term does not make the benchmark poems members of either arm. Keep the full collection size and shared error term in notes. Set n_units to null under the no-computation rule because a separate total of poems for these two arms is not explicitly printed; printed=null here refers to that missing contrast-specific output total. The separately recorded n_treatment=48, n_control=48 and n_total=96 are supported and should remain.

summary: Checked all four estimates against the complete 57,080-character markdown, including references and end matter, and PDF text on pages 2-9. Recovered Tables 1 and 2 with pymupdf.find_tables(). The saved eleven-page paper has no appendix or supplementary section. One scope error concerns Study 1 n_units, which includes the AI-only benchmark outside the extracted contrast. All recorded arm means, SDs, pairwise p-values and participant counts otherwise match the cited PDF pages and the correct outcomes and arms. Question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, AI availability, outcome timing, within_person, comparison_type and se_basis are supported for all four estimates. The paper reports inconsistent Study 1 recruitment/exclusion counts and omnibus degrees of freedom, and inconsistent Study 2 human-arm SDs and co-creator-versus-human p-values. These are manuscript discrepancies already documented in the extraction: Table 2 supports the retained human-arm SD of 4.98, and the explicitly identified pairwise comparison supports p=0.278. Coverage is complete: one eligible contrast in Study 1 and all three eligible contrasts in Study 2. Self-reports, AI-only comparisons, omnibus tests and mediation paths are appropriately excluded; figure-only numbers are omitted under extraction rule 1.
